# IVD nucleus pulposus degeneration (clean)

Bulk RNA-seq of intervertebral disc nucleus pulposus cells revealed transcriptional signatures of degeneration. FOXF1 was upregulated in degenerated versus healthy specimens (Table 4). PAX1 was upregulated in NP cells (Table 4). KRT18 was upregulated (Table 4).

SOX9 was upregulated in the degenerated condition (Table 4). ACAN was downregulated as a marker of NP phenotype loss (Table 4). COL2A1 was downregulated (Table 4).

MMP13 was upregulated, consistent with increased matrix remodeling (Table 4). ADAMTS4 was upregulated (Table 4). TNF was downregulated (Table 4). IL6 was downregulated (Table 4).
